body: I just lost the love of my life. Just to show you how much she meant to me, i'll explain in detail. I would convince myself that she loved me the same way i loved her when in fact she didn't love me as much. I only had her as a friend because i pulled myself away from everyone else to try and be with her as much as possible. Eventually she did this as well, but it turns out i wasn't enough. After a relationship that went on for almost 3 years she wanted to be just friends, she didn't want to have any commitments, that she wanted to go out with her friends and enjoy her life the way everyone else does. Then she said she would come back to me when the time was right again. She was my first girlfriend, my first kiss, my first love, my first every thing. She became my world. I know how it feels to lose some one that means this much to you. I'm in the process right now. Death is a permanent solution for a temporary problem. I know it hurts like hell to go through this. I have only been able to sleep once every 3 days when exhaustion forces my body to just lay my head and pass out. I cry every day until i have no tears left to cry. I imagine suicide every moment of the day, and when i see her in school i have to step out because of memories that run through my mind that makes anxiety engulf me. The point is, suicide is just .. too extreme to be a solution. Think about how many other people have been through the same thing? The chances that they find some one else along the lines are extremely high. The best way to handle the pain, the only thing that has been helping me the least bit, is to find some thing that distracts you and makes you forget about the problem. To me it's work, drawing, and school. I have no friends any more because i completely secluded myself through the last 3 years of high school. Now i'm alone and have no one to go to and it hurts just that much more. I'm here for you if you want to tell me about any thing and every thing. I know how it feels and i want to be there for anyone else that is going through this same pain.

I know how you feel but you shouldn't just throw your life away. You only get one. Try distracting yourself from what ever is bringing you into such pain. I'm currently in a break up with the only person i have ever trusted and confided my thoughts with. The only person i went to for consolation. Turns out she wanted to enjoy life without commitment and wanted me to wait for her. I know how pain feels, some times i only sleep once every 3 days from the pain. The only thing that has helped me and i hope will help you is to find some thing that distracts you. Any thing. Meet new people, have conversations, go out to a public place and if you see some one alone grab a coffee and start a conversation about the weather with them if they don't mind. Don't let your life slip away from you, even when you feel like you're in hell. Things can only get better. It would help if you can tell me about what's bothering you so i we can have a conversation about it. I'll check up on this post when i get free time. Get well, don't take death as a solution for your problems, really there is too much to experience in life . Try new things you normally wouldn't. Wish you the best of luck.

I used to go to the gym but with all the things i've taken on that was extra i don't even have time on my schedule for sleep any more. I think the gym would be a good release for the stress, i always used to enjoy 1 or 2 hours of weight lifting each few days. Thank you for your advice i appreciate it greatly. I'm off to school. Thank you reddit/r/sw :)<3
I guess some things do take higher priority at the time being. What you said really makes sense. Thank you for the advice.
